thread:
Mia Chen: quick help — Java SDK streaming to our private VPC endpoint (via company proxy) keeps dropping after ~10s. error: java.io.IOException: unexpected end of stream. minimal setup below:

Mia Chen: ```java
RedwoodClient client = RedwoodClient.builder()
  .baseUrl("https://private.redwood.local")
  .auth(token)
  .proxy(new Proxy(Proxy.Type.HTTP, new InetSocketAddress("proxy.corp.local", 3128)))
  .build();
client.stream(req, handler);
```

Mia Chen: no obvious 4xx/5xx in proxy logs, just the client exception. anyone seen proxy + streaming quirks?

Sanjay Patel: are you using HTTP CONNECT / tunnel for the stream? proxies that terminate TLS or rewrite headers often break long-lived streams. try bypassing proxy for the private host with NO_PROXY or proxy exclusion.

Eli Gomez: also check SNI. If proxy is doing TLS termination, it might rewrite Host header — streaming (chunked/transfer-encoding) can be effected. curl test: `curl --proxy http://proxy.corp.local:3128 -v -N https://private.redwood.local/v1/stream` and then `curl --noproxy private.redwood.local -v -N https://private.redwood.local/v1/stream` to compare.

Jessica Wu: Java-specific: if you're using OkHttp under the hood, set readTimeout to 0 for infinite streaming and disable `expect-continue` sometimes. e.g.:
```java
OkHttpClient ok = new OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .readTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
  .build();
```
Also make sure connection pool size/reuse is fine.

Eli Gomez: tiny gotcha — some proxies strip Authorization on 101 (upgrade) or on chunked uploads. If auth is header-based, either ensure proxy allows that header or try a short-lived signing header pre-connection.

infra-bot: FYI: proxy logs show upstream connection closed by proxy for sessions to private.redwood.local at 2026-03-14T11:07:xxZ. Rule proxy-rewrite-07 rewrites Host -> internal-host and may be related. Ticket INF-424 opened.

Mia Chen: disabling proxy for the host made the stream stable. thanks — good repro. follow-up q: any SDK-level recommended defaults for private endpoints (baseUrl formatting / env vars / hostname matching)? small checklist would help for docs.

Sanjay Patel: quick checklist: 1) use full host (no path) in baseUrl, e.g. "https://private.redwood.local" (no trailing path), 2) set NO_PROXY / noproxy for internal hosts, 3) ensure client readTimeout=0 for streaming, 4) prefer proxy-tunnel (CONNECT) for TLS pass-through, 5) confirm proxy preserves SNI and Authorization headers, 6) consider mTLS if proxy rewrites headers.

Jessica Wu: language tips: Java/OkHttp -> readTimeout(0), Node/fetch -> keepalive + agent with `rejectUnauthorized` if internal certs, Python/requests -> stream=True + mount adapter with pool_maxsize.

platform-ops: added short how-to to internal doc (link pasted in channel) covering NO_PROXY patterns and connector examples for Java/Node/Python.

Mia Chen: awesome — I'll incorporate this into the SDK README and open a tiny PR to set the streaming readTimeout to 0 by default for the Java client (so devs don't hit this by surprise). will paste the repro and INF-424 link in the PR.
